thresholds.route_indicator: a seed selects a route when its causal ASR contrast exceeds the already registered 0.15 minimum meaningful effect
thresholds.typical_route: the Wilson 95% lower bound on seed-level route prevalence exceeds 0.5; 0.5 is derived from the word typical meaning a majority of training runs
thresholds.installation_derivation: 0.15 + sqrt(2 ln(2/0.05)/1024); installation failures remain outcomes and are never excluded

statistics.quality_interval: paired seed bootstrap interval for the mean, 10000 resamples with fixed seed 2718 or 2719
statistics.continuous_route_summary: per-seed values, mean, and median; no Gaussian decision interval
statistics.pooled_precision: the five existing verified endpoint seeds plus 16 new seeds give n=21 and maximum Wilson half-width 0.1967, below the registered +/-0.20 target
statistics.dose_response: report route prevalence and continuous effects at all four rates, plus each seed's first table-dependent rate; no endpoint may be hidden

quality_outcomes.clean_nll: post-poison intact clean NLL minus the same seed's pre-poison clean NLL
quality_outcomes.decision: descriptive paired outcomes with bootstrap intervals; no quality-preservation threshold or gate

temporal_outcomes.report: per-seed causal table and Wilson prevalence for each route indicator; the mean Student-t interval is not used for the successor's decisions

verification.decisive: full deterministic clean adaptation, four paired optimizer profiles, quality evaluation, causal interventions, temporal interventions, aggregation, and complete prediction-row replay
verification.integrity: sealed source manifest and exact decision/metric comparison

budget.scale_justification: the stage uses 28% of the remaining budget to reduce pooled worst-case route-prevalence uncertainty below +/-0.20, replicate every reported learning-rate dose, measure paired quality cost, and increase the seed count for all G3/G3.1/G4 endpoint claims
